EasyAM works it out for you: it rings on working days and stays quiet on bank holidays and your days off, so you can stop switching alarms off and on again. items.title: Lumi Letters Lite: ABC Kids
items.content_text: Start with the letter A and the first planet, then unlock the rest only if your family loves it. Lumi Letters Lite turns the English alphabet into a starry adventure for ages 3 to 7: children hear each letter's name and sound, practise letter formation by tracing capitals and lower-case letters along stroke guides, and collect cute letter friends. Gentle enough for nursery, reception and home learning. No adverts, and it works offline.

items.title: Lumi Letters Pro: ABC Phonics
items.content_text: Real phonics for little learners: hear the sound, spot it in the word, trace the letter. Lumi Letters Pro takes children through 14 planets, 12 question types and 26 collectable letter friends. They listen for the initial, middle and end sound of a word, match capital and lower-case letters, and trace every letter along stroke guides. In the Parent Zone you can follow progress across four core skills and print a daily worksheet. No ads, no subscription, no data collection, and it works offline, ideal for nursery, reception and home learning.

items.title: Lumi Math Planet: Explorer
items.content_text: Solve a question and a little planet lights up. Lumi Math Planet turns counting, number bonds, addition, subtraction, times tables, clocks and money into a gentle space adventure for the early school years, with 46 question types shown in pictures and read aloud. Parents can follow progress, practise weak spots and print worksheets with answer keys. No ads, no subscription.

items.title: Lumi Math Pro: Kids Numbers
items.content_text: Turn real mathematical thinking into a gentle space adventure. Lumi Math Pro helps children aged 3–6 practise counting, number sense, addition, patterns, shapes and logic through short, playful challenges.

items.title: Lumi Mission Planet: Chores
items.content_text: Turn everyday routines into gentle wins for your child. Lumi Mission Planet helps children aged 3–6 practise brushing teeth, getting dressed, tidying up, bedtime steps and small chores through calm, playful missions. Stars celebrate effort and build confidence without adverts, pressure or noisy distractions.
